module: Flowgraph module (moduleOrder 0) that blocks or allows input actions while a flowgraph project is running. It keeps a set of blocked actions and, in afterTrigger, pushes the list to core_input_actionFilter under the group 'fg_filter_<manager id>'. It also stores the walking mode (gameplay_walk) allowed state at start to restore it on stop.
notes: Blocks are applied only at the end of the tick (afterTrigger), only if self.changed is true.
Probable bug: in executionStopped, the variable 'list' is not defined (nil global), so setGroup is called with nil.

Probable bug: blockActions/allowActions use the key 'k' (list index) for addActions/removeActions, and afterTrigger iterates over them with ipairs: blocks from different lists overwrite each other by index.
The values of addActions/removeActions are never cleared after being applied.

getFreeId.desc: Increments and returns a unique identifier for registering an action list.

init.desc: Called when the module is created: calls clear().

clear.desc: Resets the tables storedActions, actionsByName, addActions, removeActions and lists.

registerList.desc: Registers a list of action names and returns its identifier, which can then be used with blockActions/allowActions.

blockActions.desc: Marks the actions of the registered list as to be blocked (applied in afterTrigger).

allowActions.desc: Marks the actions of the registered list as to be allowed again (applied in afterTrigger).

afterTrigger.desc: Called by the manager after the graph tick. If changes occurred, recomputes the list of blocked actions and sends it to core_input_actionFilter (setGroup then addAction(0, group, true)).

executionStopped.desc: Called when the project stops: disables the filter group and restores the permission to toggle walking mode that was stored at start.

executionStarted.desc: Called when the project starts: stores gameplay_walk.isTogglingEnabled().
